tests.title: OKR admin configures custom fields and exports configuration to CSV for audit
tests.customer_impact: Admins cannot bulk-export field data; migration and audits are blocked.
tests.test_data_prerequisites: Staging tenant with at least two OKR custom fields and sample OKR records.
tests.preconditions: User has OKR admin role; feature flag for CSV export enabled on staging.

persona_notes.qa_engineer: Covers admin export happy path from settings through file validation — primary AC-01 revenue/audit path.
persona_notes.test_architect: Single journey spans configuration UI and export artifact; avoids separate atomic export click test.
persona_notes.automation_engineer: API setup for fields + UI export trigger; file content check may stay manual or use fixture parser.

steps.step: Open **Settings → OKR → Custom fields** and confirm existing fields list loads.
steps.expected_result: Table shows field name, type, and used-in columns for at least two fields.

steps.step: Open one field detail and note name and type for later CSV comparison.
steps.expected_result: Detail panel matches list row values.
Export starts without permission error; progress or download prompt appears.

steps.step: Download the file and open in a spreadsheet tool.
steps.expected_result: CSV header includes field name, type, and applicable goal type columns per AC-01.

steps.step: Locate the field from step 2 in the CSV.
steps.expected_result: Row values match UI name and type.

source_quotes: Admins can export custom field definitions to CSV for audit.

tests.title: Standard user completes OKR workflow but cannot export or edit field configuration
tests.customer_impact: Unauthorized users could exfiltrate configuration or change global field setup if RBAC fails.
tests.test_data_prerequisites: Standard user with access to OKR overview; at least one OKR visible; no admin rights.
tests.preconditions: Logged in as standard user without custom-field admin rights.

persona_notes.qa_engineer: Exercises allowed OKR usage then denies export/admin — RBAC AC-02 in one realistic session.
persona_notes.test_architect: Pairs with TC-001 on matrix row AC-02 without duplicating admin export steps.
persona_notes.automation_engineer: Role fixtures + API negative on export endpoint if available; UI hidden state assertions.

steps.step: Open OKR **Overview** and open an existing OKR from the tree.
steps.expected_result: Detail or side panel loads; user can view OKR data.

steps.step: Edit an inline field value allowed for standard users and save.
steps.expected_result: Value persists after refresh on the same row.
Page is blocked, read-only, or export/admin actions are hidden per product RBAC.

steps.step: Attempt export via any visible entry point (toolbar, menu, or direct URL if documented).
steps.expected_result: Export is not available or returns a clear permission error; no file download.
